# StereoBuyers

> StereoBuyers (stereobuyers.com) buys used high-end home audio and home theater equipment, including vintage stereos and components. It serves the NYC tri-state area, Palm Beach (Florida) and Denver (Colorado); the buyers come to the seller and pay on the spot. Sellers request a free quote online. Based at 481 Van Brunt St Suite 8A, Brooklyn, NY 11231. Phone: 718-260-8948.

## Key pages
- [Get a free quote](https://www.stereobuyers.com/get-a-quote/): start here to sell equipment.
